name: gemma2-jpn-pun-sft-rtx3090
source: Minami et al. 2025 inspired practical configuration
notes: Designed to fit a 24 GB RTX 3090 with QLoRA. The 2025 paper uses SFT -> preference optimization for Japanese juxtaposed puns, but this file is explicitly a practical local config, not a claim of exact paper hyperparameters. Gemma access requires accepting Google's license on Hugging Face.
